dc_eval_cbrn.quote: To assess risks related to proliferation of chemical and biological weapons for Llama 4, we applied expert-designed and other targeted evaluations
dc_eval_cbrn.note: CBRNE evaluated; no result or threshold determination reported

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Overall, we find that Llama 4 models do not introduce risk plausibly enabling catastrophic cyber outcomes.
dc_eval_cyber.note: stated threshold determination for Llama 4 on cyber

dc_eval_autonomy.note: 'autonomy' appears only as user autonomy, not a model risk

ext_test_any.note: red team composition described without saying it is outside Meta; 'partner early with subject-matter experts' informs adversarial goals, not tied to testing the model; bug bounty is post-release

ext_test_named_org.note: AI Alliance, PAI, MLCommons named as consortium memberships, not testers

safeguards_training.quote: We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.

safeguards_runtime.quote: All of our [reference implementation](https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-agentic-system) demos contain these safeguards by default
safeguards_runtime.note: Llama Guard, Prompt Guard, Code Shield shipped as defaults in reference implementation

safeguards_access.note: open release; licence and AUP only

safeguards_weights.note: weights openly released; no weight protection
